ends.note: dead end at the American Starch Co. property line (line drawn across the street)

notes: Names printed without a suffix (STRAIGHT, BOSCH, VALLEY, ALFRED) are written with 'Street'. West of Garrard the sheet is the Mill Creek rail yard and vacant creek bottom: Garrard's west line is continuous (Straight ends at Garrard, T). Alfred here is the 30' piece west of Valley (60' east of Valley on 246/254), so it is named 'Alfred Street (west of Valley)'; it crosses Garrard (Garrard continues south on 245) and runs west across the B&O SW / CCC&StL tracks (x~1000-1300) to x~280, where its north line stops near the binding with no creek or cross street drawn; not recorded as an end. Valley is at the right edge next to the binding: only its west line is drawn (x~6209-6219); the centre (x~6386-6392) is taken from the west line plus about half the printed 60' (as Valley is drawn on 246) and sits just east of the R.R. siding in the street, as on 246; uncertain by ~15 px; Straight continues east across Valley (sheet 254), so cross; Alfred (west piece) ends at Valley (T; the 60' piece east of Valley is offset south, see 246). Marshall junctions are NOT recorded: Marshall's south line is at y~210-220 and with the printed 60' its centre lies at or just above the top paper edge (Garrard/Marshall computed ~3950,38 with the paper starting at ~47; Bosch/Marshall ~4832,29 with paper at ~30; Valley/Marshall ~6084,7, off). Marshall's south line begins at x~1195 at the railroad (a line runs north from there off the sheet). Bosch runs from Marshall to its dead end. Circled 62' figures are grade elevations. No alleys.
